# Mike's thoughts (Main page)

> Welcome to my personal blog powered by Hwaro.

## Pages

- [Mike's thoughts (Main page)](http://127.0.0.1:3000/): A blog powered by Hwaro: posts, archives, and tags.
- [About](http://127.0.0.1:3000/about/): A short introduction to this blog and its author.
- [Archives](http://127.0.0.1:3000/archives/): Every blog post, sorted by date.
